description: Despite being passed nationally for Medicare patients and in 25 states, a bill to cap co-pays for insulin at $35/month and insulin supplies at $100/month did not even get a hearing in last year’s Senate (SB 222). If elected to the Florida Senate, Jason commits to co-sponsoring this legislation when
paid_for_by: Paid for by Jason Bellamy-Fults, Democrat for State Senate D-6 806 NW 33rd Ave
title: Jason Bellamy-Fults commits to support a statewide insulin cap — Jason Bellamy-Fults for Florida
